declared_rules.placement: The balloon must remain inside the exact first ComicPanelPlan safe zone with a five-percent inset.
declared_rules.protected_content: The safe zone is a planning constraint, not proof: owner review must still confirm no face, person, important hand, or story object is obscured.
declared_rules.phone_readability: Review at the panel's actual 390px-scroll footprint; target type is 13px where fit permits.
declared_rules.contrast: Measure black-type contrast against the composited backing using WCAG relative luminance; do not infer narrative or occlusion acceptance.
declared_rules.decision: This experiment may recommend a treatment but cannot accept art, dialogue, lettering, or a production base.

boundaries: Local compositing only; no provider call, upload, API, or budget use.
Review copy is explicitly non-canon and must not enter a ComicPanelPlan or script.
Generated source pixels remain ignored and unaccepted.
The selected system font is hash-pinned; another font build must fail closed.
